content:
rachael: Quick sync: proposing a compact fallback-first cutover playbook for EU->NA tenancy moves. focus: safety gates, legal consent, and deterministic ballot for leaderless fallback.

matt: Sounds good. main ops risk last time was rapid fallback traffic. want explicit inflight caps + queue depth checks before swap.

jyoti: Agreed. High-level flow: 1) consent filter 2) kv-snapshot 3) kms/HSM preflight 4) prewarm standby 5) canary 6) lease-swap (controller or leaderless ballot) 7) promote 8) post-validate.

sam: Checklist to include in runbook:
- confirm consent.csv (natalie)
- confirm KMS key present in target region
- run kv-snapshot and stash to s3://residency-archives/$CUTOVER_ID
- prewarm standby pools with weights and cache priming
- canary 1% for 10m; abort if errors>0.5% or p95>220ms

natalie: I'll deliver consent.csv by 10:30Z. format: tenant_id,jurisdiction,consent:true/false. will mark GDPR=no-copy tenants.

rachael: Operator commands we should standardize into scripts:
`./ops/consent_check --file tenants.csv || exit 1`
`./ops/kv_capture --tenants tenants.csv --dest s3://.../$CUTOVER_ID`
`./ops/kms_preflight --region na --key-list tenants.csv`
`curl -X POST /v1/pools/standby?action=prewarm&cutover=$CUTOVER_ID`
`route-control --set-route percent=1 --region na --cutover $CUTOVER_ID --duration 10m`
`./ops/leases_swap --tenants tenants.csv --mode auto (controller|ballot-fallback)`
`curl -X POST /v1/pools/promote?cutover=$CUTOVER_ID`

matt: For `leases_swap`, define auto as controller-coordinated; if controller unreachable >30s switch to ballot-fallback. Ballot format: <cutover_id>-<region_priority>-<proxy_id>. swap allowed only when: ballot higher than active + 3/5 proxy quorum AND snapshot checksum matches. log ballot and quorum to KV metadata.

jyoti: Add pre-swap invariants: inflight_requests_per_tenant < 300, outstanding_kv_writes < 100, p95 < 200ms. If any invariant violated, hold. Also require consent_stamp_age < 24h.

sam: Observability: add `cutover_id` and `ballot` tags to metrics/traces. include `X-Cutover-ID` header and emit `cutover_id` in request logs. Pre-make a Grafana dash for cutover filters.

oliver: For the leaderless fallback, need deterministic tie-breaker for concurrent ballots. make region_priority deterministic and monotonic; proxies must persist last_seen_ballot to local stable storage. Include a short anti-entropy window after promote: shadow reads to old primary for 5-10m and compute mismatch rate. If mismatch_rate > 0.5% revert.

rachael: Rollback steps to put in runbook:
`route-control --set-route percent=0 --region na --cutover $CUTOVER_ID`
`curl -X POST /v1/leases/revert?tenants=@tenants.csv`
`curl -X POST /v1/pools/standby?action=drain&cutover=$CUTOVER_ID`
`ops notify --page "cutover aborted $CUTOVER_ID"`

jyoti: Post-validate probes: sample 200 keys across tenants, compare checksums; sample 50 prompts to test embedding parity (cosine distance threshold 0.12). If checks fail trigger revert and page SRE.

matt: Add a dry-run mode to all ops scripts so we can exercise preflight without touching routing. `--dry-run` should simulate lease counts and checklists.

infra-bot: deploybot: Registered cutover plan cutover-3578901234 created by rachael. Canary scheduled 2026-04-02T14:00Z.

rachael: Action items:
- rachael: draft runbook + implement --dry-run in ops scripts
- matt: implement ballot persistence lib and unit tests
- jyoti: checksum & embedding probes, anti-entropy reporter
- natalie: consent.csv + exclusion list
- sam: cutover dashboard and metrics tags

rachael: I'll push the initial doc to docs/runbooks/residency-cutovers and request reviews. ping here when ready. :white_check_mark:
